cues.brief: Faint mechanical projector whirr with soft clatter, small room, loop; says "old film". Whirr only under every 1932 shot [0,1737).
cues.note: Loop to frame 1737; planned silences keep this bed alone.

cues.brief: Dry steady hiss of wind through ripe wheat, open plain, loop, a far raven.
cues.note: [0,868); the B02-SH06 rustle swell at 652-670 is part of this bed.

cues.brief: MUS-01 march intro: snare roll from 0, brass sting at frame 47 ("ปืนกล"), cut dead at 106 ("ถอนทัพ").
cues.note: Sting lands at file 1.57 s = frame 47; the file ends at 106 (3.53 s).

cues.brief: Curious emu grunt, low throaty hm-oomph, close, dry, 0.4 s; instantly silly.
Far truck putter pulling away, 40 m, dry open air, very low, out by local 40.
Heavy padded three-toed emu step on dry stalks, mid-close, slow, low.

Soft projector gate clack for the title, 0.15 s.
cues.fit: Library file is a single tiny dry film-projector shutter click, 0.25 s: the same source, action, material and space as Film's soft projector gate clack (0.15 s, small room, dry); a new generation (ep30-gate-clack candidates) measured no closer.

cues.brief: Pecking crunches: dry wheat stalks snapping and beak clacks, several birds, close, crisp, quick, appetising; runs to the bell.
Brass hotel counter bell tapped once, bright, 0.6 s ring, cheeky, as the word ends.
One emu peck crunch behind the farmer, same family as the pecks.
1930s four-cylinder truck engine approaching and idling down, squeaky drum brakes at local 40.
Grand brass fanfare that sputters: three pompous notes, a cracked note and a tuba blat, 0.8 s; MUS-02 stops under it; blat ends by 497.
Parade snare and bass drum hit together, dry, close, 0.3 s, deadpan.
Parade snare and bass drum hit together, dry, close, 0.3 s, deadpan.
Parade snare and bass drum hit together, dry, close, 0.3 s, deadpan.
MUS-02 re-enters dipped about 20 dB under L19 so the count lands dry; runs to 660.
One small unimpressed beak click, very close, 0.08 s, deadpan; the only effect under L19.
MUS-02 snare roll crescendo (660-667) into a brass-and-snare tutti hit that cuts dead on "ยิง!" at 673; no decay.
cues.note: File is 13 frames; it ends at 673 exactly. Owned by B03-SH05.

cues.brief: Lewis gun burst: 23 sharp cracks exactly 0.100 s apart, open plain, mic 2-3 m behind; the viewer should flinch. Full 690-704 and 718-726 (before and in the pause of "แผนแรก"), ducked about 6 dB under the words, full again from 756.
cues.note: Attack at about 20 ms into the file: place the file start on frame 690 (first crack 690, 23rd crack 756). Natural tail 0.45 s runs into the ring.

cues.brief: Title gate clack tucked under the burst.

cues.brief: Light brass cases flicking out, tinkling on hard dry dirt and stalks, close right, 2.4 s.
Startled emus, ripple of low alarmed grunts and wing rustles, 30-50 m away, 1 s.
Second take as the clumps bolt.
Lewis bolt slamming back and holding open, one heavy steel clack, very close, dry, final.
Faint high ear-ring with the plain's dry echo dying under it, 1.2 s decay; sudden emptiness; carries into B03-SH02.
Many heavy feet thudding off in different directions, stalks snapping, feather flutter, wide stereo, 1.5 s.
Emu signal, up-slide: cheeky slide-whistle glide with wing 1 (815-821).
cues.note: Mime beat: the only emu voice; no vocal sound.

cues.brief: Emu signal, down-slide with wing 2 (831-837).
Crisp dry papery wing-flap swish, left.
Crisp dry papery wing-flap swish, right.
Fast patter of five sets of clawed feet running off, panned out left, 0.8 s.

cues.brief: MUS-04 ambush vamp: sneaky low pizzicato strings and muted tuba; ducks 12 dB at 1003, stops dead at 1035.
Water lapping at the earth bank with a slow dry windmill creak every 2 s (first near local 10); low throughout to 1150.
Orderly many-bird shuffle, padded footsteps in a slow almost marching rhythm, mid-distance, dry.
The unison step: one combined soft thump-shuffle of many feet, 0.3 s, comic precision.
Lewis gun burst, closer: 11 cracks exactly 0.100 s apart, wetter slap off water and earth bank, ends dead on the last crack (1033) with no tail; ducked about 6 dB under the words.
cues.note: Attack at about 18 ms; last crack at file 1.000 s = frame 1033; file ends 1.07 s.

cues.brief: Hot brass pinging on a dry earth slope and plopping with a tiny hiss into shallow water, close, 1 s.
Rounds slapping into mud and shallow water along the shore, small wet thuds and splashes 8-15 m away, low.
A few sharp low emu grunts, wing flaps, two splashes as birds hop into the shallows, 6-10 m, 1 s.
Softer ear ring, 9-frame decay, gone by 1044. No cooling ticks.
Steel bolt stopping short, one dry deflating click on dead silence, very close, 0.2 s.
Soft smoke puff fff, 0.3 s.
Single bright brass casing tinkle on stone, bounces, 0.3 s.
Lewis cocking handle yanked back and run home, steel on steel, clean and practised, 0.17 s; done by 1067.
One more hopeless dry trigger click off screen, softer, 1.5 m off-axis, 0.1 s, in L23's pause 1091-1093.
Tiny dry wristwatch tick-tick (1106, 1109) as the wing settles, very close, about 18 dB under the voice; Editor may drop it if it masks "ตอนนี้" (O10).
Patient clawed foot tap on packed wet dirt, soft thud with a tiny claw click, close, unhurried; clear of L23 and L12.
Patient clawed foot tap on packed wet dirt, soft thud with a tiny claw click, close, unhurried; clear of L23 and L12.

cues.brief: MUS-05 fast bouncy brass galop about 140 bpm, the first music since "ยิง!"; deflates into the tuba slide.
Truck engine labouring in low gear, four-cylinder petrol at high revs, rattling tray chains; loop to 1294 and under B05-SH02.
Emu running feet low under the engine, heavy three-toed runners on a dirt track, many, mid-distance (loop to 1294).
Old steel leaf-spring creak and chassis bang, close, short, comic but real.

Second single shot going nowhere.
Truck putter receding, low, with evening wind.
Evening wind through wheat, lighter; AMB-P under B05 and B06 to 1737 (the engine bed rides over it to 1294).

cues.brief: Tuba glissando down, 1.2 s, sad-funny, ending on "ถอนทัพ" at 1350; music out after it.
Lone cornet four-note retreat call, slightly flat, at a distance, 1.0 s; last note ends at 1393 under L21.
Tiny shop-door bell, two quick jingles, close, 0.4 s, cheerful "come again"; done by 1437.
MUS-06 low admiring brass chorale, mock-solemn; swell on "ถัง" 1530; cut clean at 1542.
Slow-motion emu footfalls, padded thuds pitched down, slow, close, low.
Tank-tread clank with a low engine growl on EMU-HERO's footfall, 1.0 s, ducked under the word's tail.
MUS-06b soft held brass chord under the bow, resolves on the ting at 1563, out by 1578.
cues.note: Mime beat: effects and music only.

cues.brief: Soft slow downward feather-and-cloth swish as the neck dips, close, 0.5 s, gracious (1549-1563).
One small polite ting at the bottom of the bow, tiny triangle, 0.4 s.
Faint scatter of tiny polite applause, far, 0.4 s; reads as taking a compliment. All out by 1578.
Truck putter arriving (1607-1625), same engine family.
Movie-trailer hit on "ภาคสอง": big low boom with a cymbal swell, 1.5 s, ducked under the word.
MUS-07 slower, slightly detuned march from "ลากยาว" to the cut at 1737.
Projector rattle accelerating then decelerating, 1.3 s, over the time-lapse jumps (1639-1678).
Truck putter receding.
Same off-key bugle callback; its 1.0 s tail runs past the cut, Editor fades it over 1733-1741.
Projector motor slowing to a stop, 0.8 s; the old-record filter opens on the cut.
Clean city exterior: soft far traffic, light breeze, one magpie warble near frame 1797, no filter, to the end 1977.
MUS-08 original warm anthem-style brass pad rising from 1741, full fidelity; pulls back at 1884; never the real anthem.
Emu boom as in B01-SH03, now clean hi-fi (no old-record filter), 0.7 s, as the head turn settles.
Ending button: small brass band resolves on a warm major chord with one clean parade-snare flam, ringing 1.3 s to the end at 1977; fade nothing.
